description: A feature-expansion update introducing universal search, Manga reader support, and a broader content discovery experience.

items.desc: Universal search across Anime, Manga, and Settings from a single input.
Integrated Manga reader with support for both page-by-page and scroll reading modes.
Watch and reading progress tracking that persists across sessions.
Community forums accessible directly within the platform.
User-curated lists and bookmarking for Anime and Manga titles.
Individual title rating and review system.
